results.name: Pentwater Credit Fund
results.strategy_description:
The Fund employs a flexible mandate across corporate credit; the strategy is not dependent upon a distressed cycle to generate attractive investment returns. Capital is opportunistically deployed on a bottom-up basis across three core sub-strategies: liquid event driven, senior performing credit, and deep value opportunities. Allocations to the sub-strategies will vary over time and are dependent on the manager’s evaluation of the relative attractiveness of each sub-strategy’s opportunity set. Trades are generally structured in an effort to generate attractive investment returns based on a distinct idiosyncratic catalyst  and/or event thereby lessening the correlation to market volatility. For each position, the team is focused on identifying mis-priced risk with a set of key catalysts which we believe will create trading opportunities over the life of each investment; the team follows a disciplined trading strategy for each position based on defined entry/exit points which will impact the sizing of each investment over time. The team will optimize exposure with all available instruments (debt, equity, derivatives). Trade ideas are sourced on a global basis, with a primary focus on North America. 

We employ an “all weather” approach to investing across the corporate credit market with a focus on identifying specific events and/or catalysts that will directly lead to a change in underlying securities prices. We believe our expertise is in our ability to identify catalysts on a timeline and predict how securities will react to those catalysts; active management of each investment allows us to reposition through catalysts and optimize our exposure with all available instruments (debt, equity, derivatives) . Disciplined focus on entry and exit strategy facilitates superior execution and monetization of investments and mitigates risk of macroeconomic shifts. We maintain a bottoms-up fundamental research approach to our investment process which is supplemented by quantitative analytics and portfolio management techniques. The team generally aims to have average holding periods of less than 12 months with an emphasis on maintaining ample portfolio and position level liquidity.

results.name: Pentwater Unconstrained Fund
results.strategy_description:
The Fund is invested opportunistically on a bottoms-up basis between Hard Catalyst / Merger Arbitrage, Soft Catalyst / Special Situations, and Catalyst Driven Credit / Distressed investments. Hard catalyst / merger arbitrage investing typically involves mergers (including pre-announced acquisitions), tender offers, exchange offers, proxy contests or other transactions where one company is attempting to acquire another. Soft catalyst / special situations investments frequently have a value component with a catalyst attached and can be across a company’s entire capital structure. They typically involve spin offs, carve outs, stub trades, purchases or sales of assets or subsidiaries that can change the equity value or credit profiles of companies, share class arbitrage, activist investing, time spreads and holding company arbitrage. Catalyst driven credit investing may include private and non-investment grade debt, distressed credit, bankruptcies and liquidations, capital structure arbitrage and post-restructured equities.

We believe Pentwater differentiates itself from peers through its active trading strategy and utilization of options to structure positions. For each transaction, the team will identify a set of key catalysts on a timeline which are expected to create trading opportunities over the life of a deal. The team makes extensive use of options (when available) to structure positions in an effort to optimize risk/reward ratios. The team actively trades around positions, and is sensitive to entry/exit points as well as growing/reducing positions at different points over the life of the transaction

results.strategy_description: The Pharo Gaia Fund, Ltd. is a global macro hedge fund that specialises in emerging markets. It aims to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns, independent of the market cycle and external conditions. The Fund is managed by the Firm’s most senior members of the investment team (Guillaume Fonkenell and Nicolas Beckmann). They trade the full emerging market universe (e.g., Latin America, Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East and Africa) as well as developed markets (e.g., North America, Japan, Western Europe and Australia). The Fund’s core asset classes are foreign exchange, credit (primarily sovereign, but also, quasi-sovereign and corporate), and local market rates. Guillaume Fonkenell and Nicolas Beckmann have access to a shared pool of human and technological resources: economists, execution traders, quantitative analysts, and quantitative strategy tools. From there, each individual's idea generation and trade expression are unique. They have full discretion over their capital allocation, subject to well-defined risk controls. Capital is allocated by the Risk Committee.

The aim of the strategy focuses on delivering consistent uncorrelated returns with limited volatility throughout a cycle.

results.name: Sone Capital
results.strategy_description: Sone Capital seeks to generate attractive, uncorrelated returns with low volatility through the pursuit of a market-neutral equity long/short strategy. The strategy uses proprietary in-house fundamental Net Asset Value (NAV) data to systematically construct Relative Value (RV) trades within a curated universe of global developed market equities. The universe is comprised of quality companies with durable earnings streams driving stable, narrowly bounded NAVs. Sone’s investment team is responsible for continuously updating the underwriting of NAVs using a Bayesian process, ensuring the integration of new information in real time. The strategy pursues tight fundamental fit of longs and shorts, allowing for leveraged market-neutral exposure, while emphasizing idiosyncratic mispricing. Sone manages this RV strategy using the proprietary data and code base developed over two decades at Echo Street. Portfolio construction incorporates higher gross exposure and little to no net exposure.
